title: StateWeaver: Multi-Agent Coordination of Story-State Transitions for Long-Horizon Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.34290v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern video foundation models generate high-quality short clips, but preserving long-video consistency and correctly depicting event-driven state changes remain challenging. Existing agentic workflows face these challenges because continual planning and repair accumulate context, while reference updates remain limited. We introduce StateWeaver, which combines Active States and Hierarchical Collaboration to connect review-driven visual reference updates with cross-shot state inheritance. Active States translate state discrepancies identified during review into concrete visual asset requirements that guide reference construction, validation, and regeneration, preserving identity and already-correct content while repairing target attributes. translated_title: StateWeaver：面向长时程视频生成的多智能体故事状态转换协调
translated_abstract: 现代视频基础模型能够生成高质量的短视频片段，但保持长视频的一致性以及正确描绘事件驱动的状态变化仍然具有挑战性。现有的智能体工作流程之所以面临这些挑战，是因为持续的规划与修复会不断累积上下文，而参考更新却仍然有限。我们提出了StateWeaver，它结合了主动状态与分层协作，将基于审查的视觉参考更新与跨镜头状态继承联系起来。主动状态将审查过程中识别出的状态差异转化为具体的视觉资产需求，这些需求指导参考的构建、验证与重新生成，在修复目标属性的同时保留角色身份和已经正确的内容。已确认的生成结果会与相应的资产状态、故事时间以及参考版本关联起来，以便后续镜头进行验证和复用。分层协作则将执行（部分内容截断）
tldr: StateWeaver通过主动状态与分层协作机制，将审查驱动的视觉参考更新与跨镜头状态继承相结合，解决了长视频生成中的一致性与事件驱动状态变化难题。
en_tdlr: StateWeaver combines Active States and Hierarchical Collaboration to link review-driven visual reference updates with cross-shot state inheritance, enabling consistent long-horizon video generation with accurate event-driven state transitions.
